issue: The red 'UNUSED capacity (N ≥ 22)' region is bounded above by C_analytic and below by S=40, so it includes the 5% throughput-efficiency derate (C_analytic − C_eff), not only demand-capped unused capacity.
evidence: At N=60, C_analytic = 60×17/8.6 ≈ 118.6 req/s, C_eff = 0.95×C_analytic ≈ 112.7 req/s, S = 40 req/s. The shaded region spans from S to C_analytic, so it contains ≈5.9 req/s of derate plus ≈72.7 req/s of unused demand; the label says 'insufficient offered demand' and 'not scheduling overhead'.
acceptance_test: Shade only C_eff − S as unused demand; show C_analytic − C_eff as a separate hatched/derate band, or relabel the shaded region as 'capacity above served demand (includes 5% efficiency derate)' and add a separate derate annotation. Verify at N=22 and N=60 that the shaded area matches the stated quantity.

issue: The six gates are drawn below each stage rather than on the transition seams, and the top-row arrows imply unconditional Data→Train→Eval→... progression; the caption says PASS permits the next stage.
evidence: Gate boxes sit under Data/Train/Eval/Canary/Observe/Promote with dotted vertical connectors; the top-row arrows between stages are separate and have no PASS dependency. A reader can infer that the stage transition happens regardless of the gate, with the gate as a side check.
acceptance_test: Place each gate on the corresponding transition arrow, or add an explicit PASS arrow from each gate to the next stage and keep the FAIL branch to the rollback bar. Verify that removing a PASS arrow visibly blocks the next stage.

issue: The green production-feedback line returns only to the Data stage, while the caption says it returns evidence to 'data/evaluation, where the gates apply again'; the line does not enter a gate or branch to Eval.
evidence: Green loop from Serve terminates at Data; no branch to Eval and no connection to the Data/Eval gate boxes. Caption: 'Production feedback returns evidence to data/evaluation, where the gates apply again.'
acceptance_test: Route the feedback line to the Data and Eval gate inputs (or add branches to both stages/gates), or change the caption to 'data' only. Verify the drawn endpoints match every noun and gate in the caption.

issue: The two key prefill terms—linear 2·N·L and quadratic 4·n_layers·L²·d—are both drawn as solid lines distinguished only by color, so they are not reliably distinguishable in grayscale.
evidence: Legend: red solid = 'linear 2·N·L'; purple solid = 'quadratic 4·n_layers·L²·d'. Both have the same stroke pattern; grayscale conversion collapses the color difference.
acceptance_test: Change one solid line to a distinct dash pattern (e.g., long-dash) or add direct on-line labels; verify the figure in grayscale at print size that the two terms remain identifiable without color.

issue: The causal-triangle crossover is annotated at ~106.8K tokens, but the left panel's x-axis ends at 10² = 100K tokens, so the claimed intersection is outside the plotted range and the arrow points to the plot edge rather than the actual crossing.
evidence: Left panel x-axis ticks: 10⁰, 10¹, 10²; annotation: 'causal-triangle quad term overtakes linear ~106.8K'. The red solid and blue dash-dot lines meet at or beyond the right edge, not at a visible 106.8K point.
acceptance_test: Extend the x-axis to at least 1.2×10² (or 2×10²) so the 106.8K intersection is inside the plot, or add an off-plot arrow/note stating the crossover is beyond the plotted range. Verify the intersection is visually at ~106.8K.

issue: The '3 Exposure' box uses white text on a light orange fill, which has weak contrast and becomes weaker in grayscale.
evidence: Box 3 is orange with white label text; the other boxes use darker fills. In grayscale the orange becomes light grey, reducing white-text contrast.
acceptance_test: Darken the orange fill or switch to black text; verify the label remains legible in grayscale at print size.
